carousel.excerpt: Directed by Tinu Suresh Desai and written by Gyanendra Vasudev, the Hindi film pairs a love story with large-scale action and is slated for theatres in the first half of 2027.
carousel.image_caption: Ahan Shetty, who began shooting the Hindi action drama Sanki in Bhopal on October 30.
carousel.nri_angle: Sanki is Ahan Shetty's next theatrical outing after Border 2, with a first-half 2027 release planned.

carousel.title: Sold-Out Eden Park Crowd to Break New Zealand Bilateral Record for India T20I
carousel.excerpt: Nearly 40,000 fans will watch Friday's fourth T20I in Auckland, passing the 36,523 mark set in 2019 — for a series India have already won.
carousel.image_caption: Beautiful panorama of Eden Park stadium in Auckland, New Zealand, photographed by Kiwi Flickr. Friday's fourth T20I between New Zealand and India at Eden Park is sold out, with nearly 40,000 fans expected in Auckland.

carousel.title: SpaceX Fires Up Ship 42 as Flight 15 Targets First-Ever Starship Tower Catch
carousel.excerpt: SpaceX has completed static-fire tests on both stages of Starship Flight 15 — a full six-engine burn and a single-engine deorbit rehearsal on Ship 42, after a 33-engine firing of Booster 22 — ahead of a November launch that aims to catch both stages at the tower.
carousel.image_caption: Starship's Ship 42 upper stage stands on its test stand at Starbase, Texas, in a graphic marking its six-engine static fire. Ship 42 completed full-duration six-engine and single-engine static fires ahead of Flight 15.
carousel.nri_angle: Starship's progress toward full reusability is closely watched by India's growing space sector and diaspora engineers across the US aerospace industry.

carousel.title: Blackstone's Next $50 Billion in India Will Go Beyond Offices and Malls
carousel.excerpt: The firm plans to double India exposure to $100 billion in five years, expanding from real estate into infrastructure, credit, healthcare and data centres.
carousel.nri_angle: Blackstone's $100 billion India target signals deepening foreign institutional capital in sectors where diaspora investors and founders are active.
